# yutu

CLI, MCP server, and AI agent to automate YouTube workflows. This is the Rust build of [yutu](https://github.com/eat-pray-ai/yutu).

```shell
npm i -g @yutu-rs/yutu
yutu version
```

npm installs the one `@yutu-rs/yutu-<os>-<arch>` package that matches your platform as an optional dependency. The `yutu` command runs its binary. No package in this set runs an install script.

Run it as an MCP server:

```shell
yutu mcp
```

See the [README](https://github.com/eat-pray-ai/yutu#readme) for credentials and every command.
